reviews.author: Saila Wazir
reviews.text:
I recently visited the salon for a hair treatment, but unfortunately, my overall experience was quite disappointing.

The salon was very crowded and there seemed to be fewer staff available to manage the number of clients. I had left my baby at home and came to the salon expecting the service to be completed within a reasonable time. I requested Roma twice to arrange two staff members to help with the hair ironing, but unfortunately, my request was not accommodated.

I would like to appreciate the girl who was doing my hair straightening. She was polite and tried her best to help and manage the situation, and I really appreciate her effort. However, the overall staff support was not cooperative, which made the experience more stressful and time-consuming.

I would also request the salon management to be more considerate towards clients who have small children at home. Many mothers leave their babies with someone at home and come to the salon for a service, so unnecessary delays can be very difficult for them. If a client politely requests some assistance to finish the service a little faster, the staff should try their best to cooperate when possible.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves the staff coordination, customer service, and overall experience for clients in the future.

reviews.author: Mrunal Gaonkar (Mrunal)
reviews.text: I have been to so many salons before, but usually, when it gets late, the staff rush through everything just to go home and compromise heavily on the quality of their service. Hafsa Salon is completely different they are an absolute blessing!My friend and I arrived around 8:00 PM. Even though they had many other customers and it was getting quite late, they did not rush us at all. They started our appointment with a professional, thorough consultation and a mandatory patch test before putting any color on our hair, which showed me how much they truly care about hair safety and health.I got a gorgeous global hair color, stunning multi-dimensional highlights, a flawless manicure/pedicure, and clean gel polish. My friend got a beautiful hair color transformation and a deeply relaxing body polishing treatment. The results are absolutely awesome!Because we received so many detailed treatments, we were the very last customers to leave the salon at 1:00 AM! Trust me, despite the late hour, the staff never once compromised on their service. They remained incredibly patient, professional, and sweet until the very last second.Those humble, beautiful staff members are real shezadis (princesses) at heart! ❤️ Their hospitality and dedication are unmatched. If you want a luxury experience where you are truly valued as a customer, this is the best place to go. Thank you so much, Hafsa Salon team! I will definitely be a customer for life!
